notes: YoloToken is the yolo (YOLO) ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers deliver the exact requested amount with no fee or burn. There are no administrative powers, post-deployment minting, initialization calls, or application contracts. The pool pairs YOLO with IMD at a 1.25% fee. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, totalSupply, and the token address.
